Your first little build

  1. Add a shape. Click a building block, draw a 2D profile, or import an STL.
  2. Make it fit. Enter exact sizes and positions in millimeters, or drag the colored arrows. Click a piece to select it.
  3. Stack pieces. Choose a target in “Place & stack”. The selected piece is centered on top of it.
  4. Make a cut. Switch a shape to Hole. Position it inside a solid, then open Result preview to see the cut.
  5. Keep your work. Save project preserves all editable pieces. Export STL creates the finished model for Bambu Studio.

Imported STL files are triangle meshes: you can resize, rotate, stack, and cut them, but their original sketches aren't recoverable. Imports must describe closed solids.

Keyboard: Delete removes a piece; ⌘/Ctrl D duplicates; ⌘/Ctrl Z undoes. Files use millimeters. Browser autosave is a convenience; save a project file for a reliable backup.
